killedBy: the screen capture adapter fails a capture whose measured selector matched nothing, but not one that is merely hidden
why: Stops noticing that a measured selector matched nothing, which is how a renamed class turns a state's report into an empty caption while the screenshot still looks plausible. Deliberately NOT an is-visible check: several states exist to show a control is ABSENT, so presence is the property that distinguishes 'the control is hidden, as intended' from 'this state is measuring nothing at all'. Pinned by a case that drives the real adapter with the child process stubbed through its own `deps.runProcess` seam -- an earlier version named a catalogue test that could not possibly see this and SURVIVED, which is how the gap showed up.
